description: Kept the two stops, kept the new comedy off the afternoon plot, and sent the pass.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Put the man out, chart and all, and kept the sixpence supper.
name: Alice Brambleby

description: Held the songs and left Nick and Sam uncalled.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Gave the news, named forty ships and the Queen's blessing, and cited the salt-beef barges.
name: Davy Gannet

description: Distinguished a doubt from a sin.
name: George Bryan

description: Asked for a known door and refused to rehearse a thinner house a day early.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Kept the respectful question, and let the man leave.
name: Will Kemp

description: Said he had doubted the count, and stayed.
name: William Shakespeare
